milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near one of the dead bushes (at ~3,0,4 or ~5,0,6) and face toward it, confirming visual observation. Target set to (4, 0, 5) which is the midpoint between the two dead bushes. max_distance=16 is generous since the bushes are only 3-6 blocks from spawn, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking in the right direction.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the chiseled red sandstone structure (centered at ~8,1,8) and face toward it. The structure is 7-9 blocks from spawn. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.
